# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Security and responsible use

- [ ] The change preserves public-address filtering, the fixed HTTPS test target, and bounded concurrency.
- [ ] No real proxy endpoints, credentials, personal data, or sensitive operational output were committed.
- [ ] New or changed sources satisfy `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff linting and formatting pass.
- [ ] mypy and Bandit pass.
- [ ] Dependency checks pass.
- [ ] Release-asset checks pass when distribution files change.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes.
